Preserve an interface while changing its implementation or host.

Evidence: 32/41 repositories, 29/36 families; 32 trajectories (17 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: ACP emulation, server hosting, transport adapter, and backend registry.
Negative control: A similar function signature without protocol compatibility is insufficient.
